description: A stage of a claim sequence: one escalation level with its own interval and delivery

stage.description: Position of the stage in the sequence (1, 2, 3, ...). Set by the storage from the position in the stages list; a value sent by the client is overwritten

name.description: Display name of the stage, e.g. 1st claim. Not unique within the sequence

deliveryType.description: How the claim of this stage reaches the vendor: MANUAL outside FOLIO, INTEGRATION through a Claims integration of the vendor

transmissionMethod.description: Transmission method of the vendor's Claims integration to use; required for INTEGRATION, not allowed for MANUAL

interval.description: Time interval (in days) the vendor has after a claim of this stage

internalNote.description: Internal note for claims sent at this stage

externalNote.description: External note to share with the vendor for claims sent at this stage
